features.name: Hit Points
features.description: Hit Dice: 1d6 per Sorcerer level. HP at 1st level: 6 + Constitution modifier.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.description: Weapons: Daggers, Darts, Slings, Quarterstaffs, Light Crossbows. Saving Throws: Constitution, Charisma.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose 2 skills from the Sorcerer list.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: An event in your past, or in the life of a parent or ancestor, left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with arcane magic. Your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose a sorcerous origin, which describes the source of your innate magical power.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: At 2nd level, you tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects. You have 2 sorcery points at 2nd level, and you gain one more sorcery point every time you level up, to a maximum of 20 at level 20.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. Choose two Metamagic options.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class. Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Starting at 6th level, you have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll.

options.name: Component Pouch
options.description: Spellcasting focus — replaces material components without cost

options.name: Arcane Focus
options.description: Crystal, orb, rod, staff, or wand — spellcasting focus

features.name: Hit Points
features.description: Hit Dice: 1d8 per Warlock level. Hit Points at 1st Level: 8 + your Constitution modifier. Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per Warlock level after 1st.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.description: Armor: Light armor. Weapons: Simple weapons. Tools: None. Saving Throws: Wisdom, Charisma. Skills: Choose 2 from Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose 2 skills from the Warlock list.

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: You have struck a bargain with an otherworldly being. Your choice of patron shapes your Expanded Spell List, and grants you features at 1st, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Your arcane research and the magic bestowed on you by your patron have given you facility with spells. You have a number of pact magic spell slots determined by your level. All your slots are the same level (pact slot level). You regain all expended slots on a short or long rest. You know a number of spells equal to your Warlock level, choosing from the Warlock spell list (plus your Patron's Expanded Spell List).

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed Eldritch Invocations — fragments of forbidden knowledge. You gain 2 invocations at 2nd level. You gain an additional invocation at 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level. If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation. Whenever you gain a warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another.

invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
invocations.description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Beast Speech
invocations.description: You can cast Speak with Animals at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Beguiling Influence
invocations.description: You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
invocations.description: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell.

invocations.name: Eldritch Sight
invocations.description: You can cast Detect Magic at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
invocations.description: You can read all writing.

invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
invocations.description: You can cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
invocations.description: You can use your action to touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn.

invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
invocations.description: You can cast Disguise Self at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Misty Visions
invocations.description: You can cast Silent Image at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Thief of Five Fates
invocations.description: You can cast Bane once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
invocations.description: When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma modifier to the damage it deals on a hit.

invocations.name: Lance of Lethargy
invocations.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your Eldritch Blast, you can reduce that creature's speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

invocations.name: Repelling Blast
invocations.description: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

invocations.name: Eldritch Spear
invocations.description: When you cast Eldritch Blast, its range is 300 feet.

invocations.name: Grasp of Hadar
invocations.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your Eldritch Blast, you can move that creature in a straight line 10 feet closer to you.

invocations.name: One with Shadows
invocations.description: When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible until you move or take an action or a reaction.

invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
invocations.description: You can attack with your pact weapon twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

invocations.name: Tomb of Levistus
invocations.description: As a reaction when you take damage, you can entomb yourself in ice, which melts away at the end of your next turn. You gain 10 temporary hit points per warlock level, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. You are then vulnerable to fire damage and restrained until the effect ends.

invocations.name: Undying Servitude
invocations.description: You can cast Animate Dead without using a spell slot. Once you do so, you can't cast it this way again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Bewitching Whispers
invocations.description: You can cast Compulsion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Dreadful Word
invocations.description: You can cast Confusion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Sculptor of Flesh
invocations.description: You can cast Polymorph once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Ascendant Step
invocations.description: You can cast Levitate on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Minions of Chaos
invocations.description: You can cast Conjure Elemental once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
invocations.description: You can cast Jump on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Improved Pact Weapon
invocations.description: You can use any weapon you summon with your Pact of the Blade feature as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells. In addition, the weapon gains a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, unless it is a magic weapon that already has a bonus to those rolls. Finally, the weapon you conjure can be a shortbow, longbow, light crossbow, or hand crossbow.

invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
invocations.description: You can breathe underwater, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. You can also cast Water Breathing without expending a spell slot. Once you do so, you can't cast it this way again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Chains of Carceri
invocations.description: You can cast Hold Monster at will — targeting a celestial, fiend, or elemental — without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a long rest before you can use this invocation on the same creature again.

invocations.name: Shroud of Shadow
invocations.description: You can cast Invisibility at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Witch Sight
invocations.description: You can see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion or transmutation magic while the creature is within 30 feet of you and within line of sight.

invocations.name: Voice of the Chain Master
invocations.description: You can communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through your familiar's senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. Additionally, while perceiving through your familiar's senses, you can also speak through your familiar in your own voice, even if your familiar is normally incapable of speech.

invocations.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
invocations.description: You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Choose two 1st-level spells that have the ritual tag from any class's spell list (e.g. Alarm, Detect Magic, Find Familiar, Identify, Illusory Script, Tenser's Floating Disk, Unseen Servant). The spells appear in the book and don't count against your spells known. With your Book of Shadows in hand, you can cast them as rituals. If you encounter a spell in written form, you can add it to your Book of Shadows if it is on any class's spell list, the spell's level is no higher than half your Warlock level (rounded up), and you spend 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level. Ritual spells: Alarm, Ceremony, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Detect Poison and Disease, Find Familiar, Identify, Illusory Script, Speak with Animals, Tenser's Floating Disk, Unseen Servant, Animal Messenger, Beast Sense, Gentle Repose, Magic Mouth, Silence, Skywrite, Augury, Clairvoyance, Meld into Stone, Nondetection, Speak with Dead, Speak with Plants, Water Breathing, Water Walk, Divination, Leomund's Tiny Hut, Drawmij's Instant Summons, Planar Binding, Rary's Telepathic Bond, Forbiddance, Word of Recall.

subChoice.prompt: Note your chosen ritual spells in your character notes
subChoice.note: Choose 2 ritual spells from any class list to inscribe in your Book of Shadows.

invocations.name: Lifedrinker
invocations.description: When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

features.name: Pact Boon
options: Pact of the Blade — create a pact weapon in your hand as an action. You are proficient with it and can use it as a spellcasting focus. It counts as magical. You can transform a magic weapon into your pact weapon by performing a ritual over 1 hour.
Pact of the Chain — you learn Find Familiar and can summon special familiars: imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite. Your familiar can attack as a bonus action instead of you.
Pact of the Tome — your patron gives you a Book of Shadows containing 3 cantrips from any class's spell list. They count as Warlock cantrips for you.
Pact of the Talisman — your patron gives you an amulet. When the wearer fails an ability check, they can add a d4 to the result. You can give it to another creature.
features.description: Your patron grants you a boon at 3rd level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Cannot exceed 20.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th)
features.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 6th-level spell from the Warlock spell list as this arcanum. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (7th)
features.description: Choose one 7th-level spell from the Warlock spell list as your arcanum. Once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (8th)
features.description: Choose one 8th-level spell from the Warlock spell list as your arcanum. Once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (9th)
features.description: Choose one 9th-level spell from the Warlock spell list as your arcanum. Once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: You can draw on your inner reserve of mystical power while entreating your patron to regain expended spell slots. You can spend 1 minute entreating your patron for aid to regain all your expended pact magic spell slots. Once you regain spell slots with this feature, you must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Fiend)
features.description: The Fiend lets you choose from an expanded list of spells. Fiend Expanded Spells: 1st: Burning Hands, Command; 2nd: Blindness/Deafness, Scorching Ray; 3rd: Fireball, Stinking Cloud; 4th: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; 5th: Flame Strike, Hallow.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: Starting at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your Warlock level (minimum of 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Starting at 6th level, you can call on your patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add a d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Starting at 10th level, you can choose one damage type when you finish a short or long rest. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. At the end of your next turn, the target returns to the space it previously occupied. The creature takes 10d10 psychic damage as it reels from its horrific experience.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Archfey)
features.description: Archfey Expanded Spells: 1st: Faerie Fire, Sleep; 2nd: Calm Emotions, Phantasmal Force; 3rd: Blink, Plant Growth; 4th: Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility; 5th: Dominate Person, Seeming.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: Starting at 1st level, your patron bestows upon you the ability to project the beguiling and fearsome presence of the fey. As an action, you can cause each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. The creatures that fail are all charmed or frightened (your choice) until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Starting at 6th level, you can vanish in a puff of mist in response to harm. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You remain invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, your patron teaches you how to turn the mind-affecting magic of your enemies against them. You are immune to being charmed, and when another creature attempts to charm you, you can use your reaction to attempt to turn the charm back on that creature. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until the creature takes any damage.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: Starting at 14th level, you can plunge a creature into an illusory realm. As an action, choose a creature that you can see within 60 feet. It must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. On a failed save, it is charmed or frightened (your choice) for 1 minute. Until the spell ends, the creature is under a hallucination of your choosing.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Great Old One)
features.description: The Great Old One lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a Warlock spell. These spells count as Warlock spells for you and are added to your available spell list. 1st level: Dissonant Whispers, Tasha's Hideous Laughter; 2nd level: Detect Thoughts, Phantasmal Force; 3rd level: Clairvoyance, Sending; 4th level: Dominate Beast, Evard's Black Tentacles; 5th level: Dominate Person, Telekinesis.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: Starting at 1st level, your alien knowledge gives you the ability to touch the minds of other creatures. You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 30 feet. You don't need to share a language, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: At 6th level, you learn to magically ward yourself against attack and turn an enemy's failed strike into good luck for yourself. When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that roll. If the attack misses you, your next attack roll against the creature has advantage.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Starting at 10th level, your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it. You also have resistance to psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of damage.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to infect a humanoid's mind with the alien magic of your patron. You can use your action to touch an incapacitated humanoid. That creature is then charmed by you until a Remove Curse spell is cast on it or until you use this feature again.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Celestial)
features.description: Celestial Expanded Spells: 1st: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt; 2nd: Flaming Sphere, Lesser Restoration; 3rd: Daylight, Revivify; 4th: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire; 5th: Flame Strike, Greater Restoration.

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.description: At 1st level, you learn the Light and Sacred Flame cantrips. They count as warlock cantrips for you, but they don't count against your number of cantrips known.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: At 1st level, you gain the ability to channel celestial energy to heal wounds. You have a pool of d6s that you spend to fuel this healing. The number of dice in the pool equals 1 + your warlock level. As a bonus action, you can heal one creature you can see within 60 feet by spending up to half your warlock level (rounded up) dice from the pool. The creature regains hit points equal to the rolled total. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your link to the Celestial allows you to serve as a conduit for radiant energy. You have resistance to radiant damage, and when you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, you add your Charisma modifier to one radiant or fire damage roll of that spell.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: Starting at 10th level, you gain temporary hit points whenever you finish a short or long rest. These temporary hit points equal your warlock level + your Charisma modifier. Additionally, choose up to five creatures you can see at the end of the rest. Those creatures each gain temporary hit points equal to half your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: Starting at 14th level, the radiant energy you channel allows you to resist death. When you have to make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you can instead spring back to your feet with a burst of radiant energy. You regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum, and then you stand up. Each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to 2d8 + your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Undying)
features.description: Undying Expanded Spells: 1st: False Life, Ray of Sickness; 2nd: Blindness/Deafness, Silence; 3rd: Feign Death, Speak with Dead; 4th: Aura of Life, Death Ward; 5th: Contagion, Legend Lore.

features.name: Among the Dead
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you learn the Spare the Dying cantrip, which counts as a warlock cantrip for you. You also have advantage on saving throws against any disease. Additionally, undead have difficulty harming you. If an undead targets you directly with an attack or a harmful spell, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC (an undead needn't make the save when it includes you in an area effect, such as the explosion of fireball).

features.name: Defy Death
features.description: Starting at 6th level, you can give yourself vitality when you cheat death or when you help someone else cheat it. You can regain hit points equal to 1d8 + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 hit point) when you succeed on a death saving throw or when you stabilize a creature with Spare the Dying.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can hold your breath indefinitely, and you don't require food, water, or sleep, although you still require rest to reduce exhaustion and still benefit from finishing short and long rests. In addition, you age at a slower rate. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year, and you are immune to being magically aged.

features.name: Indestructible Life
features.description: When you reach 14th level, you partake of some of the true secrets of the Undying. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d8 + your warlock level. Additionally, if you put a severed body part of yours back in place when you use this feature, the part reattaches.

options.name: Component Pouch
options.description: Spellcasting focus — replaces material components without cost

options.name: Arcane Focus
options.description: Crystal, orb, rod, staff, or wand — spellcasting focus

options.name: Scholar's Pack
options.description: Backpack, book of lore, bottle of ink, ink pen, 10 sheets parchment, bag of sand, small knife

options.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
options.description: Crowbar, hammer, pitons, torches, tinderbox, rations, waterskin, rope

Artificer.name: Artificer
Artificer.description: Masters of invention, artificers use ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects. They see magic as a complex system waiting to be decoded and then harnessed in their spells and inventions.
toolProficiencies: One type of artisan's tools of your choice

fixed.name: Thieves' tools and a dungeoneer's pack

features.name: Hit Points
features.description: Hit Dice: 1d8 per artificer level. Hit Points at 1st Level: 8 + your Constitution modifier. Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per artificer level after 1st.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.description: Choose 2 skills from: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand.

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.description: At 1st level, you've learned how to invest a spark of magic into mundane objects. To use this ability, you must have thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand. You then touch a Tiny nonmagical object as an action and give it one of the following magical properties: shedding light, emitting a recorded message, emitting an odor or nonverbal sound, or creating a visual effect. You can have a number of such objects active at once equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). You can dismiss an object's magic as an action.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You've studied the workings of magic and how to cast spells, channeling the magic through objects. Spell Slots: The Artificer table shows how many spell slots you have. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier. Infuse Item: You learn to channel magic into objects (gained at 2nd level).

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Infuse Item

invocations.name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
invocations.description: The wearer of this armor gains these benefits: The wearer's walking speed increases by 5 feet. The armor includes gauntlets, each of which is a magic melee weapon that can be wielded only when the hand is holding nothing. The gauntlet deals 1d8 force damage on a hit and has the thrown property, with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals your spell save DC) or be pushed up to 10 feet away from you in a horizontal direction.

invocations.name: Armor of Magical Strength
invocations.description: This armor has 6 charges. The wearer can expend the armor's charges in the following ways: When the wearer makes a Strength check or a Strength saving throw, it can expend 1 charge to add a bonus to the roll equal to its Intelligence modifier. When an effect would knock the wearer prone, it can expend 1 charge as a reaction to avoid being knocked prone. The armor regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Boots of the Winding Path
invocations.description: While wearing these boots, a creature can teleport up to 15 feet as a bonus action to an unoccupied space the creature can see. The creature must have occupied that space at some point during the current turn.

invocations.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
invocations.description: While holding this rod, orb, or staff, a creature gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores half cover when making a spell attack. The bonus increases to +2 when you reach 10th level in this class.

invocations.name: Enhanced Defense
invocations.description: A creature gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wearing (armor) or wielding (shield) the infused item. The bonus increases to +2 when you reach 10th level in this class.

invocations.name: Enhanced Weapon
invocations.description: A simple or martial weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The bonus increases to +2 when you reach 10th level in this class.

invocations.name: Helm of Awareness
invocations.description: While wearing this helmet, a creature has advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, the wearer can't be surprised, provided it isn't incapacitated.

invocations.name: Homunculus Servant
invocations.description: You learn intricate methods for magically creating a special homunculus that serves you. The item you infuse serves as the creature's heart, around which the creature's body instantly forms. You determine the homunculus's appearance. It is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands.

invocations.name: Mind Sharpener
invocations.description: The infused item can send a jolt to the wearer to refocus their mind. The item has 4 charges. When the wearer fails a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, the wearer can use its reaction to expend 1 of the item's charges to succeed instead. The item regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Radiant Weapon
invocations.description: This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, the wielder can take a bonus action to cause it to shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. The wielder can extinguish the light as a bonus action. The weapon has 4 charges. As a reaction immediately after being hit by an attack, the wielder can expend 1 charge and cause the attacker to be blinded until the end of the attacker's next turn, unless the attacker succeeds on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. The weapon regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Repulsion Shield
invocations.description: A creature gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wielding this shield. The shield has 4 charges. While holding it, the wielder can use a reaction immediately after being hit by a melee attack to expend 1 of the shield's charges and push the attacker up to 15 feet away. The shield regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Resistant Armor
invocations.description: While wearing this armor, a creature has resistance to one of the following damage types, which you choose when you infuse the item: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, or thunder.

invocations.name: Returning Weapon
invocations.description: This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and it returns to the wielder's hand immediately after it is used to make a ranged attack.

invocations.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
invocations.description: While wearing this ring, the creature can recover one expended spell slot as an action. The recovered slot can be of 3rd level or lower. Once used, the ring can't be used again until the next dawn.

invocations.name: Replicate Magic Item
invocations.description: Using this infusion, you replicate a particular magic item. You can learn this infusion multiple times; each time you do so, choose a magic item that you can make with it. See the Replicate Magic Item table in Tasha's Cauldron of Everything for the full list of replicable items by level.

invocations.name: Repeating Shot
invocations.description: This magic weapon requires no ammunition. When a ranged weapon is infused with this magic, it produces its own ammunition, magically creating one piece of ammunition each time it fires. The ammunition created by the weapon vanishes the instant after it hits or misses a target. The weapon also doesn't require its user to load it. A +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls is granted by the weapon.

invocations.name: Sovereign Glue
invocations.description: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a bond between any two objects. The bond is so strong that, when dry, it can hold 5,000 pounds of weight for up to 1 hour. The item holds 1d6+1 uses of the glue, and each use bonds two objects together.

invocations.name: Bag of Holding
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: You replicate a Bag of Holding using this infusion. (Requires attunement: No)

invocations.name: Cap of Water Breathing
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: While wearing this cap underwater, you can speak its command word as an action to create a bubble of air around your head. It allows you to breathe normally underwater. This bubble stays with you until you speak the command word again, the cap is removed, or you are no longer underwater.

invocations.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can breathe underwater, and you have a swimming speed of 60 feet. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action.

invocations.name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you can see much better than normal out to a range of 1 foot. You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks that rely on sight while searching an area or studying an object within that range.

invocations.name: Goggles of Night
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: While wearing these dark lenses, you have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

invocations.name: Rope of Climbing
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: This 60-foot length of silk rope weighs 3 pounds and can hold up to 3,000 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak the command word, the rope animates. As a bonus action, you can command the other end to move toward a destination you choose.

invocations.name: Sending Stones
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: Sending stones come in pairs, with each smooth stone carved to match the other. While you touch one stone, you can use an action to cast the sending spell from it. The target is whoever is holding the other stone.

invocations.name: Wand of Magic Detection
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the detect magic spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Wand of Secrets
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: The wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges, and if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Alchemy Jug
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: This ceramic jug appears to be able to hold a gallon of liquid and weighs 12 pounds whether full or empty. Sloshing sounds can be heard from within the jug when it is shaken, even if the jug is empty. You can use an action and name one liquid from the table below to cause the jug to produce the chosen liquid.

invocations.name: Amulet of Health
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher.

invocations.name: Cloak of Protection
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

invocations.name: Hat of Disguise
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing this hat, you can use an action to cast the disguise self spell from it at will.

invocations.name: Headband of Intellect
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.

invocations.name: Medallion of Thoughts
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): The medallion has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the detect thoughts spell (save DC 13) from it. The medallion regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Pipes of Haunting
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: You must be proficient with wind instruments to use these pipes. They have 3 charges. You can use an action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature within 30 feet of you that hears you play must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute.

invocations.name: Ring of Water Walking
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and walk across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.

invocations.name: Boots of Elvenkind
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

invocations.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While you wear these boots, your walking speed becomes 30 feet, unless your walking speed is higher, and your speed isn't reduced if you are encumbered or wearing heavy armor. In addition, you can jump three times the normal distance, though you can't jump farther than your remaining movement would allow.

invocations.name: Bracers of Archery
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the longbow and shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with such weapons.

invocations.name: Brooch of Shielding
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing this brooch, you have resistance to force damage, and you have immunity to damage from the magic missile spell.

invocations.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have disadvantage, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide, as the cloak's color shifts to camouflage you.

invocations.name: Eyes of the Eagle
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.

invocations.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.

invocations.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): These gloves seem to almost meld into your hands. When a ranged weapon attack hits you while you're wearing them, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier, provided that you have a free hand.

invocations.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.

invocations.name: Winged Boots
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can use the boots to fly for up to 4 hours, all at once or in several shorter flights, each one using a minimum of 1 minute from the duration. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

invocations.name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 21, if it isn't already higher.

invocations.name: Boots of Levitation
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While you wear these boots, you can use an action to cast the levitate spell on yourself at will.

invocations.name: Boots of Speed
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots double your walking speed, and any creature that makes an opportunity attack against you has disadvantage on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.

invocations.name: Bracers of Defense
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

invocations.name: Cloak of Displacement
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While you wear this cloak, it projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

invocations.name: Cloak of the Bat
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. In an area of dim light or darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak with both hands and use it to fly at a speed of 40 feet.

invocations.name: Cube of Force
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item (requires attunement): This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it that can be pressed. The cube starts with 36 charges, and it regains 1d20 expended charges daily at dawn.

invocations.name: Dimensional Shackles
invocations.description: Replicate Magic Item: You can use an action to place these shackles on an incapacitated creature. The shackles adjust to fit a creature of Small to Large size. In addition to serving as mundane manacles, the shackles prevent a creature bound by them from using any method of extradimensional movement.

features.description: You learn 4 infusions at 2nd level. You gain more as you level: 6 at 6th, 8 at 10th, 10 at 14th, 12 at 18th. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can apply your known infusions to nonmagical items. The number of items you can have infused at once equals half your artificer level (rounded down).

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.description: Choose the type of specialist you are: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist, or Battle Smith. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 5th, 9th, and 15th level.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.description: At 3rd level, you've learned how to produce exactly the tool you need: with thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, you can magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. This creation requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work, which can coincide with a short or long rest. Though the product of magic, the tools are nonmagical, and they vanish when you use this feature again.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Arcane Armament
features.description: Starting at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn, but one of the attacks must be made with a magic weapon. This replaces the Extra Attack feature for Artificers.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: At 6th level, your proficiency bonus is now doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: At 7th level, you've gained the ability to come up with solutions under pressure. When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: When you reach 10th level, you achieve a profound understanding of how to use and make magic items: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. If you craft a magic item with a rarity of common or uncommon, it takes you a quarter of the normal time, and it costs you half as much of the usual gold.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: At 11th level, you can now store a spell in an object. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one simple or martial weapon or one item that you can use as a spellcasting focus, and you store a spell in it, choosing a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the artificer spell list that requires 1 action to cast. While holding the object, a creature can take an action to produce the spell's effect from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.description: At 14th level, your skill with magic items deepens: You can attune to up to five magic items at once. You ignore all class, race, spell, and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can attune to up to six magic items at once.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: At 20th level, you develop a mystical connection to your magic items, which you can draw on for protection: You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws per magic item you are currently attuned to. If you're reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to end one of your artificer infusions, causing you to drop to 1 hit point instead.

Alchemist.name: Alchemist
Alchemist.description: An Alchemist is an expert at combining reagents to produce mystical effects. Alchemists use their creations to give life and to leech it away.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with Alchemist's supplies. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class: 3rd — Healing Word, Ray of Sickness; 5th — Flaming Sphere, Melf's Acid Arrow; 9th — Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word; 13th — Blight, Death Ward; 17th — Cloudkill, Raise Dead.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: Beginning at 3rd level, whenever you finish a long rest, you can magically produce an experimental elixir in an empty flask you touch. Roll on the Experimental Elixir table for the elixir's effect. A creature can drink the elixir or administer it to an incapacitated creature as an action. The elixir lasts 24 hours. You can create additional elixirs by expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher for each one. You can create a number of elixirs equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) for free each long rest.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: At 5th level, you've developed masterful command of magical chemicals, enhancing the healing and damage you create through them. Whenever you cast a spell using your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus, you gain a bonus to one roll of the spell: healing spells gain +Int modifier to one die of healing; spells that deal acid, fire, necrotic, or poison damage gain +Int modifier to one damage roll.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.description: Starting at 9th level, you can incorporate restorative reagents into some of your works: Whenever a creature drinks an experimental elixir you created, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Intelligence modifier. You can cast Lesser Restoration without expending a spell slot, and it counts as an artificer spell for you. You can use this a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a long rest.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.description: By 15th level, you have been exposed to so many chemicals that they pose little risk to you, and you can use them to quickly end certain ailments: You gain resistance to acid and poison damage, and immunity to the poisoned condition. You can cast Greater Restoration and Heal without expending a spell slot, without preparing them, and without material components, provided you use alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus. Once you cast either spell with this feature, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

Armorer.name: Armorer
Armorer.description: An Armorer infuses their armor with elemental energy and turns it into a weapon. Armorers walk into the thick of combat, shielded by their extraordinary inventions.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Armorer Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared: 3rd — Magic Missile, Thunderwave; 5th — Mirror Image, Shatter; 9th — Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt; 13th — Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility; 17th — Passwall, Wall of Force.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: Your metallurgical pursuits have led to you making armor a conduit for your magic. As an action, you can turn a suit of armor you are wearing into Arcane Armor, provided you have smith's tools in hand. You gain the following benefits: The armor can't be removed against your will. The armor attaches to you and expands to cover your entire body. The armor replaces any missing limbs. If the armor normally has a Strength requirement, the Arcane Armor lacks this requirement for you. You can use the armor as a spellcasting focus. The armor attaches and detaches as a bonus action.

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: Choose your Armor Model at 3rd level. Guardian: Thunder Gauntlets (1d8 thunder, target has disadvantage on attacks against others) and Defensive Field (bonus action: gain temp HP equal to artificer level, prof bonus uses/long rest). Infiltrator: Lightning Launcher (ranged 1d6 lightning, 90ft, one hit/turn adds 1d6 lightning), Powered Steps (+5ft speed), Dampening Field (advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Armor Modifications
features.description: At 9th level, you learn how to use your Infuse Item feature to specially modify your Arcane Armor. That armor now counts as separate items for the purposes of your Infuse Item feature: chest, boots, helmet, and the armor's special weapon. Each of those items can bear one of your infusions, and the infusions transfer over if you change your armor model with the Armor Model feature.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.description: At 15th level, your Arcane Armor gains additional benefits based on its model: Guardian — Deflect Attack (use reaction when a creature you can see hits a target within 30ft; the target gets +5 AC, potentially causing the attack to miss). Infiltrator — Improved Lightning Launcher (the 1d6 bonus lightning damage applies to all hits, not just one per turn, and the launcher deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage).

Artillerist.name: Artillerist
Artillerist.description: An Artillerist specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions on a battlefield. This destructive power is valued by armies in the wars on many different worlds.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with Woodcarver's tools. If you already have this proficiency (from your level 1 tool choice), you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared: 3rd — Shield, Thunderwave; 5th — Scorching Ray, Shatter; 9th — Fireball, Wind Wall; 13th — Ice Storm, Wall of Fire; 17th — Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.description: At 3rd level, you've learned how to create a magical cannon. Using woodcarver's tools or smith's tools, you can take an action to magically create a Small or Tiny eldritch cannon in an unoccupied space. A cannon can be: Flamethrower (15ft cone, Dex save or 2d8 fire damage), Force Ballista (ranged spell attack, 2d8 force, push 5ft), or Protector (20ft radius temp HP equal to 1d8 + Int mod). You can have 1 cannon at a time (2 at level 15). As a bonus action, you can activate the cannon. It lasts 1 hour.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: At 5th level, you know how to turn a wand, staff, or rod into an arcane firearm, a conduit for your destructive spells. When you finish a long rest, you can use woodcarver's tools to carve special sigils into a wand, staff, or rod and thereby turn it into your arcane firearm. When you cast an artificer spell through the firearm, roll a d8, and you gain a bonus to one of the spell's damage rolls equal to the number rolled.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.description: Starting at 9th level, every eldritch cannon you create is more destructive: The cannon's damage rolls all increase by 1d8. As an action, you can command the cannon to detonate if you are within 60 feet of it. Doing so destroys the cannon and forces each creature within 20 feet of it to make a DC saving throw (8 + prof + Int), taking 3d8 force damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.description: At 15th level, you're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using Eldritch Cannon: You and your allies have half cover while within 10 feet of a cannon you create with Eldritch Cannon, taking advantage of the cannon's magic. You can now have two cannons at the same time.

Battle Smith.name: Battle Smith
Battle Smith.description: Armies require a good supply of weapons and armor, and someone has to fill that need. Artificers of the Battle Smith subclass defend others and target foes from a distance using the magic-infused weapon of their own creation.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with Smith's tools. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared: 3rd — Heroism, Shield; 5th — Branding Smite, Warding Bond; 9th — Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage; 13th — Aura of Purity, Fire Shield; 17th — Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, your combat training and your experiments with magic have paid off in two ways: You gain proficiency with martial weapons. When you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.description: By 3rd level, your tinkering has borne you a faithful companion, a steel defender. It's friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. In combat, the defender shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take another action. If the mending spell is cast on it, it regains 2d6 hit points. It regains half its hit points when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.description: At 9th level, you've learned new ways to channel arcane energy to harm or heal. When either you hit a target with a magic weapon attack or your steel defender hits a target, you can channel magical energy through the strike to create one of the following effects: The target takes an extra 2d6 force damage. Choose one creature or object you can see within 30 feet of the target. Magical energy leaps from the target to the chosen creature or object, healing the chosen creature for 2d6 hit points. You can use this energy a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), but you can do so no more than once on a turn. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.description: At 15th level, your Arcane Jolt and steel defender become more powerful: The extra damage and the healing of your Arcane Jolt both increase to 4d6. Your steel defender gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class. Whenever your steel defender uses its Deflect Attack, the attacker takes force damage equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier.

Acolyte.description: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods, acting as an intermediary between the realm of the holy and the mortal world.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Insight and Religion.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write two additional languages of your choice.

features.name: Shelter of the Faithful
features.description: As an acolyte, you command the respect of those who share your faith and can perform religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your companions can expect free healing and care at a temple of your faith, though you must provide material components for spells. Those who share your religion will support you at a modest lifestyle. You might have a residence at a specific temple where you have a home.

startingItems.name: Holy Symbol
startingItems.description: A holy symbol of your deity

Charlatan.description: You have always had a way with people. You know what makes them tick, you can tease out their hearts desires after a few minutes of conversation, and with a few leading questions you can read them like they were children's books.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and Sleight of Hand.

features.name: Tool Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with a disguise kit and a forgery kit.

features.name: False Identity
features.description: You have created a second identity including documentation, established acquaintances, and disguises. You can also forge documents including official papers and personal letters, as long as you have seen an example of the kind of document or handwriting you are trying to copy.

startingItems.name: Con tools
startingItems.description: Ten stoppered bottles, set of weighted dice, deck of marked cards, or signet ring of an imaginary duke

Criminal.description: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law. You have spent a lot of time among other criminals and still have contacts within the criminal underworld.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and Stealth.

features.name: Gaming Set
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice.

features.name: Thieves Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with thieves tools.

features.name: Criminal Contact
features.description: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other criminals. You know how to get messages to and from your contact, even over great distances, through messengers, corrupt caravan masters, and seedy sailors.

Entertainer.description: You thrive in front of an audience. You know how to entrance them, entertain them, and even inspire them. Your poetics can stir the hearts of those who hear you, awakening grief or joy, laughter or anger.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Acrobatics and Performance.

features.name: Musical Instrument
features.description: You gain proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

features.name: Disguise Kit
features.description: You gain proficiency with a disguise kit.

features.name: By Popular Demand
features.description: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, theatre, or noble's court. You receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard as long as you perform each night. Your performance makes you something of a local figure wherever you have performed.

startingItems.name: The favor of an admirer
startingItems.description: Love letter, lock of hair, or trinket

Folk Hero.description: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more. Already the people of your home village regard you as their champion, and your destiny calls you to stand against the tyrants and monsters that threaten the common folk everywhere.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Animal Handling and Survival.

features.name: Artisans Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Vehicles (Land)
features.description: You gain proficiency with vehicles (land).

features.name: Rustic Hospitality
features.description: Since you come from the ranks of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

Hermit.description: You lived in seclusion either in a sheltered community such as a monastery, or entirely alone for a formative part of your life. In your time apart from the clamour of society, you found quiet, solitude, and perhaps some of the answers you were looking for.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Medicine and Religion.

features.name: Herbalism Kit
features.description: You gain proficiency with an herbalism kit.

features.name: Language
features.description: You can speak, read, and write one additional language of your choice.

features.name: Discovery
features.description: The quiet seclusion of your extended hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery. The exact nature of this revelation is up to you and your DM, but it might be a great truth about the cosmos, the deities, the powerful beings of the outer planes, or the forces of nature. It might be a site that no one else has ever seen, or a fact long forgotten, or a relic of the past that could rewrite history.

startingItems.name: Scroll case with notes
startingItems.description: Notes from your studies or prayers

Noble.description: You understand wealth, power, and privilege. You carry a noble title, and your family owns land, collects taxes, and wields significant political influence.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in History and Persuasion.

features.name: Gaming Set
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice.

features.name: Language
features.description: You can speak, read, and write one additional language of your choice.

features.name: Position of Privilege
features.description: Thanks to your noble birth, people are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcome in high society, and people assume you have the right to be wherever you are. The common folk make every effort to accommodate you, and other people of high birth treat you as a member of the same social sphere. You can secure an audience with a local noble if you need to.

Outlander.description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilisation and the comforts of town and technology. You have witnessed the migration of herds larger than forests and survived weather more extreme than any city-dweller could comprehend.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Survival.

features.name: Musical Instrument
features.description: You gain proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

features.name: Language
features.description: You can speak, read, and write one additional language of your choice.

features.name: Wanderer
features.description: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and other features around you. In addition, you can find food and fresh water for yourself and up to five other people each day, provided that the land offers berries, small game, water, and so forth.

Sage.description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse. You scoured manuscripts, studied under sages, and pored over anything you could get your hands on. Your efforts have paid off with a wealth of arcane knowledge.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose any 2 skills to be proficient in.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write two additional languages of your choice.

features.name: Researcher
features.description: When you attempt to learn or recall a piece of lore, if you do not know that information, you often know where and from whom you can obtain it. Usually this comes from a library, scriptorium, university, or sage. Your DM might rule that the knowledge you seek is secreted away in an almost inaccessible place, or that it simply cannot be found. Unearthing the deepest secrets of the multiverse can require an adventure or even a whole campaign.

Sailor.description: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years. In that time, you faced down mighty storms, monsters of the deep, and those who wanted to sink your craft to the bottomless depths.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Perception.

features.name: Navigators Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with navigator's tools.

features.name: Vehicles (Water)
features.description: You gain proficiency with vehicles (water).

features.name: Ships Passage
features.description: When you need to, you can secure free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and your adventuring companions. You might sail on the ship you served on, or another ship you have good relations with. In return for your free passage, you and your companions are expected to assist the crew during the voyage.

Soldier.description: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armor, and learned basic survival techniques, including how to stay alive on the battlefield.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Intimidation.

features.name: Gaming Set
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice.

features.name: Vehicles (Land)
features.description: You gain proficiency with vehicles (land).

features.name: Military Rank
features.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organisation still recognise your authority and influence, and defer to you if they are of a lower rank. You can invoke your rank to exert influence over other soldiers and requisition simple equipment or horses for temporary use. You can usually gain access to friendly military encampments and fortresses where your rank is recognised.

startingItems.name: Trophy from fallen enemy
startingItems.description: Dagger, broken blade, or piece of a banner

startingItems.name: Deck of cards or set of dice

Urchin.description: You grew up on the streets alone, orphaned, and poor. You had no one to watch over you or to provide for you, so you learned to provide for yourself. You fought fiercely over food and kept a constant watch out for other desperate souls who might take what you had.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand and Stealth.

features.name: Disguise Kit
features.description: You gain proficiency with a disguise kit.

features.name: Thieves Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with thieves tools.

features.name: City Secrets
features.description: You know the secret patterns and flow to cities and can find passages through the urban sprawl that others would miss. When you are not in combat, you (and companions you lead) can travel between any two locations in the city twice as fast as your speed would normally allow.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A mote of fire hurls toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. Damage increases to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet from you or if you cast this spell again. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

combat.notes: Spectral hand manipulates objects up to 10 lbs

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You create one of the following magical effects: a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a flame, clean or soil an object, chill/warm/flavor food, make a colour/mark/symbol appear, or create a small trinket or illusory image.

combat.notes: Minor magical trick; countless minor effects

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Damage increases to 2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th.

combat.notes: −10 ft speed on hit

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armour made of metal. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

combat.notes: target can't take reactions

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream.

combat.notes: Sound or image illusion; Investigation check to see through

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage. Damage increases to 2d12 at 5th, 3d12 at 11th, 4d12 at 17th.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d8 necrotic damage and the target can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. If undead, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Damage scales at higher levels.

combat.notes: can't regain HP until your next turn

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

combat.notes: auto-hit, no roll needed

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any. This spell can penetrate most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

combat.notes: Sense magic within 30 ft; see school of magic

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armour, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armour or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

combat.notes: AC = 13 + Dex modifier (no armour required)

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. +1d8 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: pushed 10 ft on fail

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect, starting with the creature with the lowest current HP. Unconscious creatures are prioritised. Each sleeping creature is unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. +2d8 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: Affects 5d8 HP of creatures; +2d8 per slot above 1st
combat.slotScale: +2d8 HP of creatures affected per slot level above 1st

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature you can see. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder for the damage type. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the creature takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type. +1d8 per slot above 1st.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

combat.notes: Teleport 30 ft as a bonus action

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions. Each time a creature targets you with an attack, roll a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates. If you have 3 duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher. With 2 duplicates you must roll an 8 or higher. With 1 duplicate you must roll an 11 or higher.

combat.notes: 3 duplicates reduce hit chance (d20 ≥ 6/8/11)

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target. When using a slot of 3rd or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd.

combat.notes: Paralyzed; +1 target per slot above 2nd
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 2nd

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.description: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggestion must be worded so that the course of action sounds reasonable.

combat.notes: Target follows reasonable 1-2 sentence suggestion

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. +1d6 fire damage per slot above 3rd.

combat.notes: 20-ft radius; half on save

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect.
