If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails.

combat.notes: Counters spells 3rd level and lower automatically

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall. When you cast this spell using a slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

combat.notes: 60 ft fly speed; +1 target per slot above 3rd

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target can't move or take actions until after its next turn.

combat.notes: Double speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dex saves, extra action

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The new form can be any beast whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating).

combat.notes: Transform creature into beast of CR ≤ target level

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. Unlike regular invisibility, this spell doesn't end when you attack or cast a spell.

combat.notes: Invisible for duration; doesn't end on attack/cast

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.description: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell, and as your action each round for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time.

combat.notes: Move creature (Str save) or object up to 1,000 lbs

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-by-10-foot panels.

combat.notes: Impenetrable invisible wall; immune to damage

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw. Damage increases to 2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th.

combat.notes: no cover benefit

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

combat.notes: +1d4 to one ability check before spell ends

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

combat.notes: Stabilise creature at 0 HP

spells.name: Resistance
spells.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.

combat.notes: +1d4 to one saving throw before spell ends

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range. You create one of the following magical effects within range: your voice booms up to three times as loud, flames flicker dramatically, harmless tremors shudder, an unlocked door flies open or slams, your eyes flare with burning intensity, or you alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

combat.notes: Minor divine effects: loud voice, flames, tremors, etc.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

combat.notes: + spellcasting modifier

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw. When you cast this spell using a slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

combat.notes: +1d4 to attack rolls and saves for up to 3 creatures; +1 target per slot

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: next attack vs target has advantage

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. +1d4 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: bonus action; + spellcasting modifier

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

combat.notes: +2 bonus to AC for duration

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack.

combat.notes: bonus action weapon; move + attack each turn; + spellcasting modifier

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

combat.notes: End one disease or condition (blinded/deafened/paralyzed/poisoned)

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

combat.notes: 20-ft radius; no sound in/out; verbal spells impossible

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey. If you are evil, they appear fiendish. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. An affected creature's speed is halved, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

combat.notes: 15-ft aura; half speed; +1d8 per slot above 3rd

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.description: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. +1d4 per slot above 3rd.

combat.notes: up to 6 creatures; bonus action

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another place of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished. If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is incapacitated. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

combat.notes: Target banished on fail; permanent if on different native plane
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 4th

spells.name: Guardian of Faith
spells.description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity. Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

combat.notes: 10 ft from spectral guardian; no scaling

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.description: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target's exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target: one effect that charmed or petrified the target, one curse, any reduction to an ability score, or one effect reducing the target's hit point maximum.

combat.notes: Remove exhaustion, charm, petrify, curse, ability reduction, or HP max reduction

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.description: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. +1d6 fire and +1d6 radiant per slot above 5th.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range: a tiny, harmless sensory effect predicting the weather; cause a flower to bloom; create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect such as falling leaves or a puff of wind; or light or snuff a candle, torch, or small campfire.

combat.notes: Minor nature effects: weather prediction, cause flower to bloom, etc.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. The weapon also becomes magical, if it isn't already.

combat.notes: Uses spellcasting modifier instead of STR

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes 1d6 piercing damage, and if the creature is Large or smaller, you pull the creature up to 10 feet closer to you. Damage increases at higher levels.

combat.notes: pull Large or smaller 10 ft closer

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the entangling plants until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Restrained in 20-ft square; difficult terrain for duration

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, a beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it can perceive or has perceived within the past day.

combat.notes: Communicate verbally with beasts for 10 minutes

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, dim light fills the cylinder. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it is engulfed in ghostly flames that cause searing pain, and it must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes 2d10 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

combat.notes: 5-ft cylinder; Con save each turn

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armour it is wearing.

combat.notes: AC can't be less than 16 regardless of armour

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.description: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see within range directly above you. The spell fails if you can't see a point in the air where the storm cloud could appear. When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see under the cloud. A bolt of lightning flashes down to that point. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

combat.notes: Call bolt each round as bonus action; +1d10 per slot above 3rd

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.description: This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two possible uses for the spell, granting either immediate or long-term benefits. If you cast this spell using 1 action, choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot radius centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.

combat.notes: Difficult terrain in 100-ft radius; OR enrich land over 8 hours

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.description: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

combat.notes: Resistance to nonmagical B/P/S damage

spells.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
spells.description: You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears: one fey creature of challenge rating 2 or lower, two fey creatures of challenge rating 1 or lower, four fey creatures of challenge rating 1/2 or lower, or eight fey creatures of challenge rating 1/4 or lower.

combat.notes: Summon fey creatures up to CR 2 (or multiple lower CR)

spells.name: Insect Plague
spells.description: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The sphere remains for the duration, and its area is lightly obscured. The sphere's area is difficult terrain. When the area appears, each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 4d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

combat.notes: 20-ft radius; difficult terrain; repeats each turn

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. Damage increases to 2d4 at 5th, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th.

combat.notes: disadvantage on next attack roll on fail

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. +1 target per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: Charmed as friendly; +1 target per slot above 1st
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 1st

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have to move away. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: target must move away on fail

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw. +1d8 per slot above 2nd.

combat.notes: inorganic materials have disadvantage

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell. +1 target per slot above 2nd.

combat.notes: Invisible until attack/cast; +1 target per slot above 2nd

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.description: You create a twisting pattern of colours that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

combat.notes: Charmed and incapacitated (speed 0) in 30-ft cube

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Choose any creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

combat.notes: End spell of 3rd level or lower; ability check for higher

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction. You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity.

combat.notes: Teleport self + one creature up to 500 ft

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.description: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. While the target is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence.

combat.notes: Charmed humanoid obeys telepathic commands

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: 15-ft cone; half on save

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

combat.notes: multiple beams at higher levels (2 at 5th, 3 at 11th, 4 at 17th)

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability. Duration increases at higher slots.

combat.notes: +1d6 necrotic per hit; disadvantage on chosen ability checks
combat.slotScale: Can target a new creature when current target drops to 0 HP without using a new spell slot

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as spectral frost that covers you and your gear. You gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage. +5 temp HP and cold damage per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: 5 temp HP; 5 cold damage to melee attacker; +5 per slot

spells.name: Hunger of Hadar
spells.description: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors. A 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and bitter cold appears centered on a point within range. The void is filled with a cacophony of soft whispers and slurping noises. No light can illuminate the area, and creatures fully within the area are blinded. The void creates a warp in the fabric of space, and the area is difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes 2d6 cold damage. Any creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 acid damage.

combat.notes: 20-ft void sphere; darkness; 2d6 cold at start of turn, 2d6 acid Dex save at end

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.description: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane. Contacting this extraplanar intelligence can strain or even break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you take 6d6 psychic damage and are insane until you finish a long rest.

combat.notes: DC 15 Int save or 6d6 psychic and insanity until long rest

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.description: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

combat.notes: +1d4 radiant damage on weapon attacks for duration

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the spell ends.

combat.notes: +1d6 psychic on next hit; Wis save or frightened

spells.name: Command
spells.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

combat.notes: One-word command: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.description: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius.

combat.notes: Can't speak deliberate lies within 15-ft sphere

spells.name: Aura of Vitality
spells.description: Healing energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. You can use a bonus action to cause one creature in the aura (including you) to regain 2d6 hit points.

combat.notes: Bonus action heal 2d6 to one creature in 30-ft aura each turn

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.

combat.notes: Once: drop to 1 HP instead of 0; or negate instant-kill effect

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it. Duration increases at higher slots.

combat.notes: +1d6 damage to marked target; advantage on Perception/Survival to track

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Restrained by vines on failed save after next weapon hit

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. +20 ft radius per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: 20-ft heavily obscured sphere; +20 ft radius per slot

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.description: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means. A creature that receives this bonus leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage.

combat.notes: +10 Stealth to you and companions; can't be tracked non-magically

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.description: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

combat.notes: 2d4 piercing per 5 ft moved through difficult terrain area

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.description: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears: one beast of CR 2, two beasts of CR 1, four beasts of CR 1/2, or eight beasts of CR 1/4.

combat.notes: Summon beasts up to CR 2 (or multiple lower CR) for 1 hour

spells.name: Lightning Arrow
spells.description: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack during the spell's duration, the weapon's ammunition, or the weapon itself if it's a thrown weapon, transforms into a bolt of lightning. Make the attack roll normally. The target takes 4d8 lightning damage on a hit, or half as much on a miss. Whether you hit or miss, each creature within 10 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

combat.notes: Main target 4d8 (half on miss); 2d8 to creatures within 10 ft of target

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.

combat.notes: Ignore difficult terrain; immune to paralyzed/restrained from spells

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet.

combat.notes: Illuminates 10-ft radius dim light per orb

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. Any attack roll against an affected creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.

combat.notes: Attackers have advantage against outlined targets; negates invisibility

spells.name: Light
spells.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. If you target an object held or worn by a hostile creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spell.

combat.notes: Illuminates 20-ft bright light, 20-ft dim light

spells.name: Darkness
spells.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can't see through this magical darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

combat.notes: 15-ft radius magical darkness; blocks darkvision and nonmagical light

spells.name: Healing Hands
spells.description: As an action, you touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest. This is a racial trait, not a standard spell slot.

combat.notes: Uses racial trait charge, not a spell slot

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

combat.notes: Reaction when damaged; +1d10 per slot above 1st

spells.name: Blade Ward
spells.description: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and becomes sheathed in booming energy. If the target willingly moves before then, it takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends. At 5th level the initial hit deals +1d8 thunder; at 11th +2d8; at 17th +3d8.

combat.notes: Extra damage only if target moves voluntarily

spells.name: Friends
spells.description: You gain advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you. When the spell ends, the creature realizes it was charmed and may become hostile.

spells.name: Infestation
spells.description: A cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites briefly infests one creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 poison damage and move 5 feet in a random direction.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.description: You point at one creature, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 necrotic damage. If the target is missing any hit points, it instead takes 1d12 necrotic damage.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.description: Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target.

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter all creatures within 10 feet. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn. On a success it takes half damage.

spells.name: Cause Fear
spells.description: You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the spell ends. Each round the target can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.

combat.notes: Frightened condition
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 1st

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.description: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear. You also understand any written language you see, provided you touch the surface on which the words are written.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.description: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.description: You write on parchment, paper, or other suitable material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration. To others, the writing appears to be no different from a legitimate document, or it might appear to be unintelligible.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. The protection grants advantage on saving throws against these creature types, they can't frighten or charm the target, and attacks against the target from those creatures are made with disadvantage.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.description: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. It has AC 10, 1 HP, Str 2, and can't attack.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 lightning damage, and on each of your turns for the duration, you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning damage automatically. The spell ends if you use your action for anything else or if the target is out of range.

spells.name: Cloud of Daggers
spells.description: You fill the air with spinning daggers in a cube 5 feet on each side, centered on a point you choose. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the spell's area or starts its turn there.

combat.notes: Damages on entry or start of turn

spells.name: Crown of Madness
spells.description: One humanoid of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you. The charmed target must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself you choose. You must use your action each round to maintain control.

combat.notes: Forces melee attack on ally each round

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.description: You weave a distracting string of words causing creatures of your choice to make a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Perception checks until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Disadvantage on Perception checks

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.description: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Halves Strength-based weapon damage

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.

spells.name: Enemies Abound
spells.description: You reach into the mind of one creature and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the target loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe and regards all creatures as enemies until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Target treats all creatures as enemies

spells.name: Fear
spells.description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened.

combat.notes: Frightened; must use movement to flee

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.description: You transform a willing creature into a misty cloud. The target has a flying speed of 10 feet, resistance to nonmagical damage, and can't take actions or speak while transformed.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.description: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy. Choose a creature type: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. The circle prevents those creatures from entering or charming those inside.

spells.name: Pact of the Blade (ritual)
spells.description: Flavour feature — see Pact Boon feature. You can use your action to create a pact weapon in your empty hand.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement so it can be removed.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.description: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force. Make a melee spell attack on a hit for 3d6 necrotic damage and regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.

combat.notes: Regain HP equal to half damage dealt

spells.name: Blight
spells.description: Necromantic energy washes over a creature. It must make a Constitution saving throw taking 8d8 necrotic on a fail or half on success. Plants have disadvantage on the save.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.description: You attempt to charm a creature you can see. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you harm it. One additional target per slot above 4th.

combat.notes: Charmed creature is friendly

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.description: You make natural terrain look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain in a 150-foot cube. Open fields can be made to look like hills, forests, or swamps.

spells.name: Shadow of Moil
spells.description: Flame-like shadows wreathe your body until the spell ends. The shadows turn dim light to darkness and bright light to dim within 10 feet of you. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, the shadows deal 2d8 necrotic damage.

combat.notes: Reactive damage when hit by melee

spells.name: Sickening Radiance
spells.description: Dim, greenish light spreads within a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 radiant damage and suffer 1 level of exhaustion.

combat.notes: Also causes exhaustion on failed save

spells.name: Dream
spells.description: You, or a willing creature you touch, enters a trance-like state and the target messenger visits a creature within range while it sleeps and delivers a short message. The messenger can shape the dreamscape and create nightmares.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.description: Choose a creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. Works on any creature type.

combat.notes: Paralyzed — auto-crit on melee attack
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 5th

spells.name: Mislead
spells.description: You become invisible and simultaneously an illusory double appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration and you can use your action to move it up to double your speed.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.description: Attempt to bind a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within range to your service. It must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure it must obey your commands for the duration.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.description: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, modified by how well you know the target.

spells.name: Synaptic Static
spells.description: You choose a point within range and cause psychic energy to explode there. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure it takes 8d6 psychic damage and rolls a d6 and subtracts it from attack rolls, ability checks, and concentration saves for 1 minute.

combat.notes: Failed save also imposes -1d6 penalty on attacks/checks for 1 min

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.description: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils. A shimmering portal opens within the circle and leads to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice that you know.

spells.name: Wall of Light
spells.description: A shimmering wall of bright light appears at a point you choose. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the next turn. The wall can launch rays of radiant light.

combat.notes: Blinded on failed save; 4d8 radiant ray as an action

spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.description: You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Choose two points on the ground that you can see, one up to 10 feet away and the other up to 500 feet away.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.description: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Conjure Fey
spells.description: You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see. If you lose concentration, the creature remains if it is hostile to you.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.description: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses within range. Each corpse becomes a ghoul under your control.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.description: For the duration your eyes become an inky void. One creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of three effects of your choice: asleep, panicked, or sickened.

combat.notes: Choose: asleep, panicked (frightened+must flee), or sickened (disadvantage on attacks/checks)

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.description: You suggest a course of activity to up to 12 creatures. Each must make a Wisdom saving throw or follow the suggestion for the duration.

spells.name: Scatter
spells.description: The will of your patron bends space. Choose up to five creatures you can see. Each unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet.

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.description: This spell snatches the soul of a humanoid as it dies and traps it inside a tiny cage you fashion from silver wire. You can exploit the soul to gain advantage on saving throws, gain the soul's knowledge, or create undead.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.description: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8+30 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid killed by this spell rises as a zombie under your control.

combat.notes: +30 damage; killed humanoids rise as zombies

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.description: An immovable prison of force springs into existence around you. You create a cage or box of force. Creatures inside can't leave by nonmagical means.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures grasp hands and teleport to a different plane. As an attack, you make a melee spell attack; on a hit you send the target to a plane of your choice (Wisdom save to avoid).

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.description: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.description: You attempt to beguile a creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. The charmed target obeys your commands to the best of its ability.

combat.notes: Full mental domination; telepathic commands

spells.name: Glibness
spells.description: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.

spells.name: Maddening Darkness
spells.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose. Each creature must make a Wisdom saving throw when it enters the area or starts its turn there, taking 8d8 psychic damage on a fail or half on success.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane. You leave your physical bodies behind, unconscious. Your astral form can explore freely, and death in the astral form returns you to your body.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against it.

spells.name: Gate
spells.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane. The portal is a circular opening between 5 and 20 feet in diameter.

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.description: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is imprisoned by one of several methods of your choice.

combat.notes: Choose: buried, chained, hedged prison, minimus containment, slumber

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.description: You utter a word of power that compels one creature you can see to die instantly. If the creature has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

combat.notes: Instant death if target has ≤100 HP

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object. On a failed Wisdom saving throw the target is transformed into a beast, humanoid, or object (your choice). If you concentrate for the full hour the transformation becomes permanent.

spells.name: Weird
spells.description: You draw upon the power of the Far Realm to create illusory creatures in the minds of all creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes 4d10 psychic damage and is frightened.

combat.notes: Frightened; repeated saves each turn

spells.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
spells.description: A creature of your choice sees everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less isn't affected.

combat.notes: Incapacitated and prone

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the spell and as your action on each turn, you can focus your mind on any creature within 30 feet. If the creature has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak a language, it is unaffected. You learn the surface thoughts of that creature.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.description: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On failure, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 10-foot cube that only the target can perceive. Each round the target takes 1d6 psychic damage.

combat.notes: Illusory object perceived only by target

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.description: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you or in an obvious location. The sensor remains for the duration. You can use your action to switch between seeing or hearing through the sensor.

spells.name: Sending
spells.description: You send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind and can reply in a message of 25 words or fewer.

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.description: You attempt to beguile a beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. While charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as you are on the same plane.

combat.notes: Charmed beast obeys telepathic commands

spells.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
spells.description: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 bludgeoning damage and be restrained. A restrained creature takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

combat.notes: Restrained on failed save; ongoing 3d6 each turn

spells.name: Alarm
spells.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, window, or an area within range no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

spells.name: Identify
spells.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them.

spells.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
spells.description: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space within range. The disk can hold up to 500 pounds.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.description: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast in range and speak a message of up to 25 words. The beast will travel to a target destination you designate.

spells.name: Augury
spells.description: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action within the next 30 minutes.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: You touch a willing beast. For the duration, you can use your action to see through the beast's eyes and hear what it hears, and continue to do so until you use your action to return to your normal senses.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.description: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can't become undead. The spell also effectively extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.description: You implant a message within an object in range, a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met. The message is spoken in your voice and is no louder than a normal conversation.

spells.name: Skywrite
spells.description: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words appear to be made of cloud and remain in place for the spell's duration.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. For the duration, the target appears dead and is blinded and incapacitated, has resistance to all damage except psychic, and is immune to poison.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.description: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. Nothing of your presence remains visible to inspection.

spells.name: Nondetection
spells.description: For the duration, you hide a target from divination magic. The target can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.description: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse can answer up to five questions. It knows only what it knew in life.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.description: You imbue plants within 30 feet with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.description: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface as if it were harmless solid ground. Up to ten willing creatures can benefit.

spells.name: Divination
spells.description: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question about a specific goal, event, or activity within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply.

spells.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
spells.description: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you. Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside. The atmosphere inside the dome is comfortable regardless of the weather outside.

spells.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
spells.description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures within range. Psychic messages can be transmitted among the bonded creatures at will.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.description: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space within range. Creatures can't teleport into the area or use portals within the area. You can designate damage types.

spells.name: Word of Recall
spells.description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You must designate such a place by casting this spell there.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

spells.name: Control Flames
spells.description: You choose nonmagical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You affect it in one of several ways: instantaneously expand/extinguish it, double/halve its illumination radius, change its color, or cause it to flicker.

spells.name: Create Bonfire
spells.description: You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage. A creature that enters the bonfire for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must also make this save.

spells.name: Decompose
spells.description: You reach out and touch a corpse. Over the next minute, the corpse begins to rapidly decompose, sprouting fungus and moss as it breaks down into compost.

spells.name: Encode Thoughts
spells.description: You pull a memory, an idea, or a message from your mind and transform it into a tangible string of glowing energy called a thought strand. You or another creature can later cast the cantrip again to decode the strand's content.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: You cause numbing frost to form on one creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d6 cold damage, and it has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Green-Flame Blade
spells.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and green fire leaps to a different creature of your choice within 5 feet. The second creature takes fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

combat.notes: On hit: splash fire damage to nearby creature

spells.name: Gust
spells.description: You seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects: push one creature 5 feet if it fails a Strength saving throw, push an unattended object 10 feet, or create a harmless sensory effect.

combat.notes: Push creature or object

spells.name: Hand of Radiance
spells.description: You raise your hand, and burning radiance erupts from it. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 radiant damage.

spells.name: Lightning Lure
spells.description: You create a lash of lightning energy that strikes at one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet in a straight line toward you and take 1d8 lightning damage if it ends within 5 feet of you.

combat.notes: Also pulls target 10 ft toward you

spells.name: Magic Stone
spells.description: You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or someone else can make a ranged spell attack with one of the pebbles by throwing it or hurling it with a sling. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Mending
spells.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. The repair leaves no trace that the object was ever damaged.

spells.name: Message
spells.description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

spells.name: Mind Sliver
spells.description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Mold Earth
spells.description: You choose a portion of dirt or stone that fits within a 5-foot cube within range and do one of the following: excavate it, move it, cause shapes/colors to appear in it, or cause it to turn into difficult terrain for 1 hour.

spells.name: Primal Savagery
spells.description: You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen, ready to deliver a corrosive attack. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 acid damage.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand. You can use your action to hurl the fire at a creature within 30 feet. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 fire damage.

spells.name: Shape Water
spells.description: You choose an area of water that fits within a 5-foot cube within range. You manipulate it in one of the following ways: move it, change its flow, change its color/opacity, or freeze it (provided no creatures are in it).

spells.name: Sword Burst
spells.description: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you. Each creature within range, other than you, must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 force damage.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away. Each creature within 5 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 thunder damage.

spells.name: Virtue
spells.description: You touch one willing creature and imbue it with vitality. If the target has at least 1 hit point, it gains 1d4 temporary hit points, which are lost when the spell ends.

spells.name: Word of Radiance
spells.description: You utter a divine word, and burning radiance erupts from you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 radiant damage.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

spells.name: Jump
spells.description: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

spells.name: Hail of Thorns
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition. The creature hit by the attack and each creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 1d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is charmed by you for the spell's duration.

spells.name: Cordon of Arrows
spells.description: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground within range and lay magic upon them to protect an area. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece of ammunition flies up to strike it.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.description: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes anything that would inflict a sudden or unexpected effect you consider harmful or undesirable.

spells.name: Locate Animals or Plants
spells.description: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.description: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.description: You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. For the duration, the target has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and it has resistance to poison damage.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.description: You call forth a bestial spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Bestial Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an environment: Air, Land, or Water. The creature resembles an animal of your choice that is native to the chosen environment.

spells.name: Conjure Barrage
spells.description: You throw a nonmagical weapon or fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition into the air to create a cone of identical weapons that shoot forward and then disappear. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.description: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object with and moves with it.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type on a hit.

combat.slotScale: +1 attack at 5th, +2d4 at 5th; +2 attack at 7th, +3d4 at 7th

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.description: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.description: You call forth a fey spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Fey Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a mood: Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy. The creature resembles a fey creature of your choice marked by the chosen mood, which determines one of the traits in its stat block.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.description: You conjure a vine that sprouts from the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. When you cast this spell, you can direct the vine to lash out at a creature within 30 feet of it that you can see. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine.

combat.notes: Pulls target 20 ft toward vine on failed save

spells.name: Guardian of Nature
spells.description: A nature spirit answers your call and transforms you into a powerful guardian. The transformation lasts until the spell ends. You choose one of the following forms: Primal Beast (your body transforms — speed increases, darkvision, claws deal 1d6 slashing), or Great Tree (your skin turns bark-like — gain 10 temp HP, advantage on Constitution checks, vines restrain).

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.description: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you.

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.description: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves or other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet.

spells.name: Conjure Volley
spells.description: You fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical weapon into the air and choose a point within range. Hundreds of duplicates of the ammunition or weapon fall in a volley from above and then disappear. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

spells.name: Swift Quiver
spells.description: You transmute your quiver so it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand when you reach for it. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition from the quiver.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.description: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. Also, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.description: You make yourself — including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person — look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs.

spells.name: False Life
spells.description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you gain 5 additional temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Grease
spells.description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range. For the duration, it is difficult terrain. When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. On a successful save, the creature can target the warded creature normally. The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage.

spells.name: Snare
spells.description: As you cast this spell, you use the rope to create a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground or the floor. When you finish casting, the rope disappears and the circle becomes a magic trap. The trap is nearly invisible, requiring a DC 20 Perception check to spot. The trap triggers when a Small, Medium, or Large creature moves onto the ground or floor in the spell's radius. The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be hoisted into the air, leaving it hanging upside down 3 feet above the ground or the floor. The creature is restrained there until the spell ends.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target's hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. Otherwise, it is impassable until it is broken or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Casting knock on the object suppresses arcane lock for 10 minutes. While affected by this spell, the object is more difficult to break or force open; the DC to break it or pick any locks on it increases by 10.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.description: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.description: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends. Bear's Endurance, Bull's Strength, Cat's Grace, Eagle's Splendor, Fox's Cunning, or Owl's Wisdom — each grants advantage on related ability checks and a bonus. At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.description: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your subsequent turns to deal this damage again. At Higher Levels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution saving throw is unaffected. The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach, which allows it to move as if it were climbing.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.description: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.description: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end of the rope, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends. The extradimensional space can be reached by climbing to the top of the rope. Up to eight Medium or smaller creatures can fit in the extradimensional space.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.description: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane, out to a range of 60 feet.

spells.name: Web
spells.description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point. The webs last for the duration. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area. A creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them during its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained as long as it remains in the webs or until it breaks free.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell. On a roll of 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane. At the start of your next turn, you return to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the space you vanished from.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.description: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures, either upon a surface or within an object that can be closed. If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. The glyph can be nearly invisible (DC 13 Investigation to notice). The glyph is triggered when a creature moves within 5 feet of it, touches it, or manipulates the object it's inscribed on.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

spells.name: Tiny Servant
